newsitem.title: UK: Tesco shares pile higher on trading news.
newsitem.headline: Tesco shares pile higher on trading news.

text.p: Shares in Tesco Plc were indicated up 4p to 306-1/2p by 0810 GMT in pre-market trade after the supermarket chain said like for like sales rose 7.5 percent in the first five weeks of the second half of the year, dealers said.
The company also reported first-half pre-tax profits increased by 10.7 percent to 321 million stg, in-line with market expectations.
"There were no surprises in the headline figures but the second-half trading news was pretty well received," one dealer said.
Tesco raised its first-half dividend to 3.25 pence compared with 3.05 pence in the same period a year ago.
